name: Occidental-Yardang
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed petrified remnants of a former biosphere in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
